features: Vivid performance, Comfortable viewing: Enjoy crisp, true-to-life visuals on an expanded 27-inch FHD display with a fast 144Hz refresh rate, 99% sRGB color accuracy, and a high 1500:1 contrast ratio—delivering fluid motion and vibrant detail in every frame

Advanced eye care: Designed for long hours of use, the display features built-in low blue light technology and TÜV-certified flicker-free performance to help reduce eye strain and fatigue during extended work or play sessions
Immersive sound: Enjoy immersive sound from the monitor’s integrated dual 3W speakers
Virtually borderless viewing: With ultra-thin bezels on all four sides, the display blends effortlessly into your space, drawing your attention to what matters most—the screen
Versatile connectivity: Quickly connect your devices through built-in HDMI, VGA, and audio-out ports
